name: Dhoot Industrial Finance Limited
about: Dhoot Industrial Finance Limited engages in the trading of chemicals and related commodities in India. It operates through Trading Activity and Financial Activity segments. The company distributes copper tubes and rods, zinc rods, carbon di sulphide, compressed hydrogen gas, chloro sulphonic acid, oleum, sodium sulphate, caustic soda lye, sulphuric acid, liquid chlorine, hydrochloric acid, and sodium hypochlorite. It also generates power through windmills. Dhoot Industrial Finance Limited was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Mumbai, India.
